commitResults.messageTitle: Bundle JavaFX natives for both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
commitResults.messageBody:
The jar only shipped the Intel macOS JavaFX libraries, so it failed to
start on Apple Silicon with "no suitable pipeline found". The Intel and
arm64 libraries share file names and cannot both sit at the jar root, so
shadowJar now stores them under natives/mac and natives/mac-aarch64.
Main copies the set matching the CPU to ~/.openjfx/tutorconnect and adds
it to java.library.path before JavaFX starts. run and tests keep using
the build machine's own Mac natives.
Bundle JavaFX natives for both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs

commitResults.messageTitle: Update User Guide for v1.6: jar name and data file location
commitResults.messageBody: Quick start named the v1.5 jar, and the guide said data is saved next to the JAR file when the app actually saves it under the folder it is launched from.
Update User Guide for v1.6: jar name and data file location

commitResults.messageTitle: Treat null entries in the data file as invalid data
commitResults.messageBody:
A null person or guardian link in tutorconnect.json made startup abort
with a NullPointerException instead of backing up the file and starting
with an empty workspace, as the User Guide promises.

Fixes PE-D bugs 'A null contact in the data file prevents startup' and
'Editing the tutorconnect.json with null literal can cause the program
to crash on startup'.

commitResults.messageTitle: Read a/l, a/p, w/o and c/o as part of a name
commitResults.messageBody:
edit tokenized 'a/l' in 'edit S1 n/Ravi a/l Kumar' as the address
prefix, truncating the name and overwriting the address. add-student
and add-guardian rejected the same connectors as unknown parameters.

Add NameConnectors (s/o, d/o, a/l, a/p, w/o, c/o as standalone words)
and use it in both the tokenizer and the unknown-prefix check.

Fixes PE-D bugs 'Editing a name containing a/l truncates the name and
overwrites the existing address' and its duplicates.
Treat null entries in the data file as invalid data
Read a/l, a/p, w/o and c/o as part of a name

commitResults.messageTitle: Stop a second TutorConnect from using the same data file
commitResults.messageBody:
Two windows on one data file saved stale snapshots over each other's
changes. Hold an OS file lock on tutorconnect.json.lock while running;
a second instance shows an alert and exits. If the lock file cannot be
created, startup continues without the protection.

Fixes PE-D bugs 'Entire saved book lost between two windows' and
'Opening the app twice: second window's save silently erases contacts'.
Stop a second TutorConnect from using the same data file

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix contact card display and link/delete messages
commitResults.messageBody:
Contact cards showed placeholder emails and addresses the user never
entered, repeated the ID as a tag and never showed guardian links.
Hide placeholders and the ID tag, and show each contact's links,
redrawing the cards after every command so link changes appear.

Name the missing ID in link errors and explain the s/ and g/ prefixes
when IDs are swapped. Describe delete ID in the delete usage message.

Document the missing unlink command as a known issue in the UG.

Fixes #96, #97, #98, #99, #100
